summary.text: Eleanor Y. Sato, a Democrat, represents House District 109 (Gorham) in the Maine House of Representatives, and lives in Gorham. The House profile lists membership on the Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: The Maine House profile lists legislative service in the House during the 132nd Legislature.
The profile lists a BFA (2019) from Fordham University.
